summary: The added marker admission routes a preserved-null existing-head continuation to executeImplementationStep; the new tests cover both a red head corrected and a green head whose marker is cleared uncharged.

evidence: src/repair/loop-work.ts:268 adds `existingHeadContinuationShape(record) && isCiFixMarker(record.wait)` to the implementation-step branch, so a marked preserved-null continuation reaches `executeImplementationStep` instead of publish or review.

src/repair/loop-implementation.ts:281 consumes that marker under the authorized continuation admission: a live candidate failure becomes the correction finding and a clean head clears the marker uncharged.

tests/repair/loop-review-existing-head-continuation_test.ts:243 covers the charged red marker correction and tests/repair/loop-review-existing-head-continuation_test.ts:303 covers the uncharged green marker clear followed by the exact-head review.
